ui_bugs.issue: Literal unicode escapes '\u00B7', '\u2192', '\u20B9', '\u203A', '\u2026', '\u2248' render as raw text in JSX (e.g. '19 Sep \u00B7 ₹649', 'Netflix went up \u20B9150 since June', 'Open Netflix \u203A Account', '\u20B9599 / year', 'save 50% \u00B7 \u2248 \u20B950/mo', 'Search Netflix, Jio, gym\u2026', 'Renewly v1.0 \u00B7 Know before it renews.'). JSX text children do NOT interpret backslash-u escapes; must use the actual Unicode character or interpolate a string literal.

critical_code_review_comments: Backslash-u escapes only work inside JS string literals, not in JSX text children. Author likely copy-pasted escape sequences from a spec. Fix by using actual characters or JS strings: {'19 Sep \u00B7 ₹649'} works, but '19 Sep \u00B7 ₹649' as bare JSX text does not.
Onboarding fix (setI + scrollToIndex) works reliably on RN Web – good pattern.

rca_of_issue: Root cause: In React (and react-native-web), backslash-u escape sequences are ONLY interpreted inside JavaScript string literals ('like \u00B7'), not when placed as raw JSX text children between tags. Example: <Text>19 Sep \u00B7 ₹649</Text> renders the literal 8 characters '\u00B7'. Fix: use the real character (<Text>19 Sep · ₹649</Text>) or interpolate a JS string (<Text>{`19 Sep \u00B7 ₹649`}</Text>).
